auth.name: Your name
auth.inviteInvalid: This invite is invalid or has expired.

surface.communicationIntro: Every customer, colleague and agent in one list.
surface.overviewIntro: What needs attention and what the agents resolved.
surface.governIntro: Autonomy posture, allowances, changes and audit.
surface.workIntro: Agents, playbooks, triggers and the run ledger.
surface.knowledgeIntro: Documents, memory and skills the agents read.
surface.connectionsIntro: Channels, models and tools your workspace is connected to.

communication.emptyQueueHint: New messages from your channels land here. Agents handle what they may; the rest waits for you.
communication.newHint: An internal thread with your default agent. Ask for a summary, a draft, or hand it a task.
communication.subject: Subject
communication.pickOneHint: Or press Ctrl K to search and run commands.
communication.costHint: Model and channel cost for this conversation

placeholder.reply: Write a reply to the customer
placeholder.note: Internal note, only colleagues and agents see this

communication.replyNeedsDecision: This reply waits for approval in the thread.
communication.agentQueued: The agent is working on it.

contacts.title: Contact
contacts.memoryHint: What agents should remember about this contact. Saved when you leave the field.

overview.attentionHint: Open threads waiting for a person
overview.euShare: {{share}} of model calls in the EU
overview.decisionsHint: Agents asked before acting. Decide here or in the thread.
overview.needsYouHint: Threads without an owner or handed off by an agent
overview.recentRunsHint: Every action an agent or tool took, with cost.

govern.postureHint: One dial for the workspace. Agents and signal types can sit below it, never above.

postureDesc.manual: Agents draft. A person sends and applies everything.
postureDesc.assisted: Agents read and write inside Bokito; communicating or external actions ask first.
postureDesc.autonomous: Agents act within allowances. Consequential tools still ask.

govern.postureDecision: Changing posture needs approval. A decision was raised in Govern.
govern.allowancesHint: Override the posture default per tool category.
govern.consequentialHint: These tools raise a decision regardless of posture.
govern.disclosureHint: Appended to AI-written replies on channels with disclosure on. Leave empty for the default.
govern.disclosureDefault: This reply was written with the help of an AI assistant.
govern.changesHint: Every configuration change, who proposed it, and a way back.
govern.auditHint: Append-only log of tool calls and settings changes.
govern.euShareHint: Model and embedding calls served in the EU
govern.tokensHint: For MCP clients, scripts and the public API. Tokens carry the workspace policy.
govern.copyToken: Copy the token now. You will not see it again.

work.newAgentHint: An agent is a passport: name, role, instructions, model and autonomy cap.
work.modelHint: Empty uses the workspace default (EU managed model or your own key).
work.autonomyCapHint: This agent never acts above this level.
work.newPlaybookHint: Steps an agent runs in order, in a thread, with the same policy as a reply.
work.noPlaybooksHint: Describe recurring work as steps. Run it by hand, from a trigger, or from a conversation.
work.playbookHint: Edit the steps; save records a change you can roll back.
work.triggersHint: Schedules and webhooks that start an agent or a playbook.
work.newTriggerHint: Cron and interval run on the worker; webhooks give you a URL and a secret.
work.cronHint: Five fields, UTC. Example: 0 9 * * 1-5 is weekdays at 09:00.
work.playbookOrInstructions: Pick a playbook or give the default agent instructions.
work.webhookSecretHint: Send POST /api/hooks/{id} with header X-Bokito-Secret. The secret is shown once.
work.ledgerHint: Every reply, playbook, trigger and tool call, with status and cost.
work.pickRun: Pick a run to see its events

knowledge.newDocHint: Markdown. Indexed for agents as soon as it is saved.
knowledge.emptyHint: Add what agents need to answer well: policies, prices, procedures, tone of voice.
knowledge.title: Title
knowledge.pathHint: Optional. Defaults to a slug of the title.

groupHint.channels: Where customers write to you. Each channel carries its own AI disclosure switch.
groupHint.models: Bring your own key. Without one, the EU managed model is used and metered.
groupHint.tools: MCP servers, workbenches and business integrations agents may call.

modules.title: Modules
modules.hint: A module adds Signal types, playbooks and tools for one line of work. It never adds a screen.
modules.installHint: Types and playbooks are added once; you can edit them afterwards under Work and Signals.
modules.uninstalled: {{name}} uninstalled. Its types and playbooks are disabled, history is kept.

settings.workspaceLanguageHint: Used for agent replies and the default disclosure line.
settings.inviteHint: They join this workspace with the role you pick.
settings.inviteLinkHint: Share this link. It is valid for seven days.
settings.apiTokensHint: Tokens for MCP clients and scripts live under Govern.
settings.endpointsHint: Everything the dashboard does is available here too.
settings.mcpClientsHint: Tools such as Cursor, Claude or ChatGPT that were granted access to this workspace through OAuth. Disconnecting revokes their tokens immediately.
settings.mcpClientsEmpty: No MCP client is connected. Point a client at the MCP endpoint above and approve it here.

oauth.title: Connect an MCP client
oauth.intro: {{client}} asks for access to the workspace {{workspace}}. It will act with your role and under the workspace policy.

scope.read: Read conversations, contacts, knowledge and decisions
scope.write: Change conversations, contacts, agents and playbooks
scope.tools: Run tools through the MCP endpoint

oauth.policyHint: Consequential actions still ask an operator in the conversation thread; that does not change with this grant.
oauth.missingClient: This link is missing a client. Start again from your MCP client.

palette.hint: Arrow keys to move, Enter to open. Tools run with your permissions and the workspace policy.
palette.decisionRaised: This action needs approval. A decision was raised.
